mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.grant_projection o JOIN auth_governance.access_grant g ON g.id=o.grant_id WHERE AND o.completed=false
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.access_grant SET state='ACTIVE',zed_token=#{token},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='PENDING'
UPDATE auth_governance.grant_projection SET completed=true,last_error=NULL WHERE grant_id=#{id} AND grant_version=#{version} AND completed=false

UPDATE auth_governance.grant_projection SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE', next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => least(60,power(2,attempts+1)::integer)) WHERE grant_id=#{id} AND grant_version=#{version} AND completed=false AND attempts < 5
mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.tenant_id,g.application_id,g.environment,g.membership_id,g.generation,g.role_id,g.scope,g.source_type,g.source_id,g.valid_from,g.valid_to,g.state,g.version,g.zed_token,g.group_id FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.application_id=g.application_id AND a.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=g.membership_id AND m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND m.generation=g.generation JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id WHERE AND a.enabled=true AND g.membership_id=#{member} AND g.generation=#{generation} AND g.state='ACTIVE' AND g.zed_token IS NOT NULL AND g.scope='TENANT_ALL' AND g.source_type='DIRECT' AND g.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND g.valid_to >clock_timestamp() AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 101
